**DR SANYAOLU ALANI AMEYE**
MBBS, FWACS, FMCORL
Consultant ENT Surgeon | Data Scientist | Clinical AI Researcher
Department of Otorhinolaryngology (ENT), King Fahad Hospital, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
Phone: +966 531 214 781 | Email: sanyaameye@hotmail.com

**Professional Summary**

Consultant Otorhinolaryngologist and data scientist with two decades of surgical practice and academic medicine, now focused on clinical artificial intelligence. Former Reader (Associate Professor) in Otorhinolaryngology at Obafemi Awolowo University, Ile-Ife, Nigeria, with 26 peer-reviewed publications and two theses. Combines deep clinical domain expertise with production-grade machine learning, applying interpretable methods (fuzzy logic, explainable ML, forecasting) to hearing loss burden analysis, audiometric classification and cochlear implant service planning. Current research spans the burden of hearing loss in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf, graded audiogram classification with fuzzy inference systems, and ML-driven clinical decision support.

**Qualifications**

- Master of Data Science — Deakin University, Australia, 2026
- Postgraduate Certificate, AI & Machine Learning — University of Texas at Austin, USA, 2024
- FWACS (ORL) — Fellow, West African College of Surgeons, Nigeria, 2012
- FMCORL — Fellow, National Postgraduate Medical College of Nigeria, 2012
- MBBS (Medicine and Surgery) — University of Ibadan, Nigeria, 1999

**Professional Experience**

- **Consultant Otorhinolaryngologist**, Department of Otorhinolaryngology (ENT), King Fahad Hospital, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia (2025 – Present). Specialist ENT care including hearing and balance disorders, cochlear implant assessment and audiologic rehabilitation.
- **Principal Healthcare AI Architect (Remote)**, AutoMedSysAI, USA (2023 – Present). Architected multimodal agentic AI systems for clinical triage; implemented differential privacy for patient data.
- **Reader (Associate Professor), Otorhinolaryngology**, Obafemi Awolowo University / OAUTHC, Ile-Ife, Nigeria (2012 – 2022). Undergraduate and postgraduate teaching, clinical service and research; lead investigator for clinical studies on hearing loss, otologic disease and surgical outcomes. Lead, Medical Illustration Unit, College of Health Sciences (2012–2019).

**Current Research Activity**

- Development and external validation of the Fuzzy Audiometric Index (FAI), an interpretable fuzzy inference system for graded audiogram classification (development manuscript under review; external validation protocol in preparation for a Saudi teaching hospital and for Obafemi Awolowo University Teaching Hospitals Complex, Nigeria).
- Burden of hearing loss in Saudi Arabia and LMICs: Global Burden of Disease analyses and forecasting, 1990–2040.
- Two abstracts accepted in principle for ArabCIC 2026, Jeddah: Saudi hearing-loss burden and fuzzy audiogram classification.

**Research Interests**

Burden of hearing loss and forecasting (GBD analysis, policy counterfactuals); fuzzy logic and interpretable AI in audiology; machine learning for clinical decision support; cochlear implant candidacy and hearing-care planning in ageing populations; data privacy in healthcare AI.
